from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,hashlib
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
from example_proof_gate import validate_current
from compcert_gate import check_spec_recheck
root=Path.cwd();case=root/'paparazzi/models/guidance_pid_h_run_pos';rel=root/'paparazzi/relations/pid_position_translation'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
parent=root/'_build/pid-cbmc124-binding-parent/20261109T052912-67dcd6d666/five-verify'
pr=json.loads((parent/'run.json').read_text())
freeze=next(c for c in pr['commands'] if 'freeze-original-sources-and-historical-attempts' in c['id'])
old=json.loads((parent/freeze['stdout']).read_text())['protected_sha256']
changed=[name for name,h in old.items() if not(root/name).is_file() or sha(root/name)!=h]
assert not changed,changed
print('Original C/models and all historical001/002 protected files unchanged:',len(old))
for base,num in [(rel,'002'),(case/'rocq/no_error','002'),(case/'rocq/termination','002'),(case/'rocq/cbmc_recheck','003')]:
 status=json.loads((base/'problem/status.json').read_text())
 assert status['status']=='proved' and status['active_attempt']=='../attempts/'+num
 validate_current(root,base/'problem',base/'attempts'/num,status)
 print('Current exact goal validation PASS:',base.name,num,len(status['requested_goals']))
new=case/'rocq/cbmc_recheck/attempts/003'
v=json.loads((new/'evidence/goal-validation.json').read_text())
assert len(v['goal_bindings'])==124
assert all('Attempt003.Proof.' in b['theorem'] for b in v['goal_bindings'])
generation=json.loads((case/'align/model/spec-map-pending.json').read_text())
assert sha(case/'align/request.json')==generation['request_sha256']
assert sha(case/'align/model/compcert-manifest.json')==generation['backend_manifest_sha256']
bindings={str((case/'align/model'/name).relative_to(root)):sha(case/'align/model'/name) for name in ['Source.v','Execution.v']}
result=check_spec_recheck(root,str((case/'rocq/spec-recheck.json').relative_to(root)),generation['request_sha256'],generation['backend_manifest_sha256'],str((case/'prepare/source/guidance_pid_h_run_pos.c').relative_to(root)),bindings)
assert result['proved']==124 and result['refuted']==0,result
print('Strict original-property recheck PASS:',result['proved'],'proved;',len(result['bindings']),'bound files')
for stage in ['prepare','cbmc','align','rocq']:
 h=json.loads((case/stage/'handoff.json').read_text())
 for row in h['outputs']:
  p=(case/row['path']).resolve();assert p.is_file(),p;assert sha(p)==row['sha256'],p
 print('Handoff hashes PASS:',stage)
required=['Proof.v','check.py','report.md','costs.json','provenance.json','evidence/goal-validation.json']
assert all((new/p).is_file() for p in required)
cost=json.loads((new/'costs.json').read_text());assert cost['schema']=='five-stage-costs/1' and len(cost['records'])==1
rec=cost['records'][0]
assert all(k in rec for k in ['time','token','memory'])
print('New attempt artifacts:',[str(p.relative_to(new)) for p in sorted(new.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()])
print('Current cost:',json.dumps({'time':rec['time'],'token':rec['token'],'memory':rec['memory']},ensure_ascii=False))
print('Final source/provenance/goal/property/handoff validation PASSED. No proof rerun needed.')
